flash_698354.description: Ahead of renewed talks between Likud and Yashar, Bennett expresses support for efforts to form a unity government but warns against attempts to drag out negotiations.

flash_698353.description:
The Knesset plenum approved the Arrangements Committee's recommendation to establish four special committees, by a vote of 55 in favor and 36 against.

The committees are the Special Committee for Eradicating Crime and Violence in Arab Society, chaired by Ra'am chairman Mansour Abbas; the Special Committee for Socioeconomic Equality, chaired by Joint List chairman Yousef Jabareen; the Special Committee for Oversight of the Implementation of the Law on Prosecution for the Events of the October 7 Massacre, chaired by MK Yulia Malinovsky (Yisrael Beytenu); and the Special Committee for Oversight of Efforts to Strengthen the Negev and Galilee, chaired by MK Noam Tibon (Together).

flash_698351.description: Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law, warns in an interview with New York Magazine that Israel risks becoming increasingly isolated on the world stage.

flash_698396.description: Strategic adviser Moshe Klughaft argues that Netanyahu wants to reverse the election results and hold another vote, and that only a credible threat of replacing him could change his position.

flash_698395.description: The Tanya compacts four millennia of Jewish wisdom to answer the great personal and existential questions of life. It has revolutionized the way we think about G -d the human soul, the world and our place in it.

flash_698394.description: The ultimate challenge in global tech projects in Israel lies in navigating the gap between corporate global culture and the volatile dynamics of the local real estate market.

flash_698392.description: The court found that an individual known to authorities for involvement in extortion effectively ran registered security firms that were used to transfer money to protection racketeers.

flash_698390.description: The employment rate among Hasidic women has jumped to 76%, but wages are lagging behind.

flash_698388.description: Jewish violence against innocent Palestinians endangers the settlements and serves terrorist organizations' propaganda. Opinion.

flash_698386.description: What caused Rachel's death while giving birth to Benjamin? An obstetrician-gynecologist's reading of the biblical verses suggests a possible complication during a breech birth.

flash_698384.description: US considers training Syrian forces despite documented abuses against Druze and Alawite minorities, potentially bringing American troops back in 2027.

flash_698382.description: I fear that one day, during the remaining two years of his presidency, Trump will wake up at nine in the morning and hear on the radio that the Shiite mullahs have built their nuclear bomb. Opinion.

flash_698380.description: After weeks of serving soldiers on the front lines, Rabbi Rafael Zikri collapsed at home and woke up paralyzed, unable to speak or swallow.

flash_698378.description: In newly disclosed testimony, Justice Sohlberg said he considered drawing a firearm during rioting by haredim in the courtyard of his home.

flash_698375.description:
ABC News reported that US President Donald Trump's annual financial disclosure shows that he held at least $12 million worth of Nvidia shares at the end of 2025.

According to the report, more than 36 transactions involving the purchase and sale of Nvidia shares, worth millions of dollars, were carried out in Trump's accounts between the beginning of the year and September.

flash_698374.description: As a new cohort of combat soldiers enlists, the commander of the Combat Intelligence Collection Training Base explains how the teams operate, combining observation, drones and robotics.

flash_698373.description: Half-measures will not save us.You cannot deter a fanatical regime with half-measures, nor can you secure Israel’s borders while leaving the sponsor of our enemies intact. Opinion.

flash_698371.description: An exhibition organized by the Palestinian mission and funded by the UN is drawing Israeli criticism for failing to mention the October 7 massacre or Hamas.

flash_698369.description: After a hyena was spotted roaming Modi'in and reportedly killed a dog, zoologist Dr. Haim Moyal explains what is driving the animal into residential areas.

flash_698367.description: New York's highest court rules that major social media companies cannot be held liable over accusations that their platforms helped radicalize gunman who carried out 2022 Buffalo massacre.

flash_698472.description: Former hostage Amit Soussana, who courageously exposed Hamas's sexual violence, is set to be nominated for the 2027 Nobel Peace Prize in recognition of her global advocacy for survivors.

flash_698471.description: A 47-year-old woman with no known underlying medical conditions was hospitalized in critical condition after contracting influenza A. She is sedated and connected to an ECMO machine.

flash_698470.description: Attorney Yair Nehorai, a leading opponent of growing religious influence, calls for ending efforts to draft haredim and disbanding the IDF's haredi units. He tells Arutz Sheva why he believes mass enlistment threatens Israel's liberal character.

flash_698468.description: In an Arutz Sheva studio interview, Maj. (res.) Yitzhaki Glick, an attorney, says Bismuth's and Liberman's draft plans fall short. He proposes universal service, a small Torah study quota and a Zionist government not reliant on haredi parties.

flash_698466.description: A 13-year-old Syrian Druze girl regained her ability to walk following surgery in Israel, 'A child is a child, regardless of where she was born,' says Prof. Salman Zarka, director of Ziv Medical Center.

flash_698464.description: An attempt to smuggle hundreds of kilograms of tobacco into Gaza was foiled at Kerem Shalom. It was hidden in sacks among winter items and sewn into blankets. COGAT froze aid entry permits for the Israeli company and trader involved.

flash_698462.description: Attorney Lior Katzav, who spoke with Netanyahu, discusses concerns over the formation of an Eisenkot-led government, warns the haredi parties and addresses the possibility of a rotation agreement with Bennett.

flash_698460.description: Former IDF Deputy Chief of Staff Maj. Gen. (res.) Uzi Dayan speaks to Hadar Miller in the Arutz Sheva studio about the October 7 failure, Israel's survival, a unity government and his journey toward religious observance and daily Talmud study.

flash_698458.description: Political leaders paid tribute to former minister Rabbi Yitzhak Levy, remembering his unwavering principles, humility, and lifelong dedication to Torah, the Land of Israel, and the Jewish people.

flash_698456.description: A 38-year-old man was seriously injured after being attacked by a wild boar in Haifa. MDA teams evacuated him to Bnei Zion Hospital in serious and unstable condition, with bruises on his limbs.

flash_698454.description: Two British synagogues cancel scheduled appearances by Rabbi Leo Dee, whose wife and daughters were murdered by terrorists, reportedly over concerns about his remarks on Gaza and comparisons to Nazi-era antisemitism.

flash_698452.description: Rami Goren told Arutz Sheva's podcast his father opposed today's Temple Mount routes. Yeshiva head Rabbi Elisha Wolfson says Goren permitted entry to large areas and that a letter he published in 5746 (1985-86) supports this view.

flash_698450.description:
The Ministry of Health announced that a person who returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo and developed symptoms that raise suspicion of Ebola was referred for examination and treatment under isolation conditions at Ichilov Hospital.

The ministry emphasizes that at this stage this is only a suspicion, and that epidemiological tests and investigations are being conducted to identify contacts.

flash_698447.description:
A person who entered the track area at Ben Gurion Airport station in violation of instructions was hit by a passing train.

Emergency and rescue teams are working at the scene, and due to the incident, there are delays and changes to train traffic in the area.

flash_698446.description: Rabbi Pinchas Goldschmidt warns that Jewish communities are becoming increasingly isolated across Europe. 'A Europe where a Jew questions his future is Europe’s failure,' says Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama.

flash_698444.description: Miri Ben Shoshan, 35, a Nova survivor, awoke to a burglar as her two children slept. She grabbed his belt before he fled via scaffolding. She told Arutz Sheva of her fear, resurfacing trauma and the police decision to close the case.

flash_698496.description: US Ambassador Mike Waltz and UN rights chief Volker Turk condemn Iran for flogging singer Parastoo Ahmadi and her team over a performance without a hijab.

flash_698495.description: The New York Times reports the CIA and two other US intelligence agencies suffered a cybersecurity breach involving an AI-powered hacking tool, with investigators eyeing possible Chinese involvement.

flash_698493.description: Trump reveals plans to meet Michigan Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed over universal health care, despite his previous fierce criticism of the Democrat's anti-Israel views.

flash_698491.description:
A California grand jury approved a two-count indictment against Thomas Markle, 82, the father of Meghan Markle, Prince Harry's wife, for possessing illegal material depicting the abuse of minors.

Markle was arrested in Florida earlier this month and initially faced only one charge. With the addition of the second charge, he faces a maximum sentence of 40 years in prison if convicted. Markle denies the allegations against him.

flash_698490.description: Israeli-Australian advocate Mai Gutman challenges Holocaust denier Myron Gaines at UCLA, where he displays Hitler's Mein Kampf and hurls antisemitic insults.

flash_698488.description: The US Embassy in Jerusalem urges Americans to exercise heightened vigilance amid Iranian and Houthi threats, warning of potential flight cancellations.

flash_698486.description: Netanyahu and Jared Kushner discuss humanitarian assistance and winter preparations in Gaza following Kushner's warning about Israel's international standing.

flash_698484.description: A new study estimates that Israel possesses approximately 90 nuclear warheads. Satellite images reveal extensive construction in Dimona and upgrades to weapons systems.

flash_698482.description: Second in a three-part series that describes Israel's relations with the Muslim world and shows that almost all possibilities are on the table. Opinion.

flash_698480.description: Our goal is not to become smaller than Hashem made us, but to recognize that whatever height we have attained is itself a gift from Him.

flash_698478.description: Yair Golan's Democrats halted talks with Yashar as unity government negotiations with Likud advanced. Eisenkot and Liberman agreed to sign a coalition deal. Likud and Yashar teams are expected to meet again tomorrow.

flash_698476.description: On his birthday, Rabbi Eli Stefansky was surprised to see Amit Segal at his Daf Yomi class. He thanked Segal and invited him to teach. Segal cited "stage fright" and discussed his studies and watching recorded classes versus attending live.

flash_698474.description:
The Turkish Ministry of Defense announced this evening that five military personnel, including two pilots and three technical staff members, were killed in the crash of a Turkish Air Force AS-532 helicopter during a training flight in the Eskisehir region.

Rescue forces have reached the remains of the helicopter. The circumstances of the crash are being investigated. This is the second fatal military helicopter accident in Turkey in less than two weeks.

flash_698469.description:
A 47-year-old woman with no known underlying medical conditions is hospitalized in critical condition at Meir Medical Center in Kfar Saba after developing complications from influenza A.

The woman was rushed to the hospital suffering from multiple organ failure. She was sedated, placed on a ventilator, and connected to an ECMO machine.

The hospital noted that the woman had been vaccinated approximately one week before falling ill, emphasizing that it takes about two weeks following vaccination for optimal protection to develop.

flash_698467.description:
Police have opened an investigation following a suspicion that a stun grenade was thrown at a house in Eilat. There were no injuries in the incident.

Police forces and forensic investigators collected evidence at the scene, and the background is suspected to be a criminal incident.

flash_698555.description: President Isaac Herzog announces nine recipients of the Israeli Presidential Medal of Honor, including Steny Hoyer, Mike Evans, Haim Saban and Bernard-Henri Lévy, in recognition of their contributions to Israel and the Jewish people.

flash_698554.description: The elections for the 26th Knesset have seen the Arab parties of UAL and the Joint List turn into a formidable parliamentary force. How did these parties start - and how did they become the balance.of power for left and right alike?

flash_698552.description:
The Knesset plenum rejected Otzma Yehudit's muezzin bill, which was intended to limit the use of public address systems in mosques.

The party attacked the Yisrael Beytenu, Beyachad, and Yashar factions that voted against the proposal, claiming that Lieberman changed his position after supporting a similar law in the previous Knesset. "Today the masks were removed in the Knesset plenum," the party said.

flash_698551.description: Three years after Yamam officer Moshael Shlomo fell in battle, a school in Ramla dedicated a Torah study hall for youth and a Torah study center for girls in his memory.

flash_698549.description: They live with the wounds of war every day, but came to Ammunition Hill to speak about the friends who never returned and to offer the younger generation hope and strength.

flash_698547.description: The prime minister's son reacted angrily to developments in his father's trial, sharply criticizing law enforcement authorities and accusing them of harming his family and the country.

flash_698545.description: Veteran correspondent Amit Segal sharply criticized the State Attorney's Office and the attorney general following the judges' remarks calling for the indictments against the prime minister to be dropped.

flash_698543.description: The finance minister sharply criticized the judges' remarks in Netanyahu's trial, demanding that the cases be closed and that those he claims framed Netanyahu be brought to justice.

flash_698541.description: Governor Bradford announced the celebration of Thanksgiving - proclaiming appreciation for the first harvest in what he called “the New Israel," the “Modern Day Promised Land" and “The New Canaan" - by citing Psalm 107.

flash_698539.description: Israel's national anthem, HaTikva (The Hope), is again under attack! Understanding what the anthem is really about (and what it is not about) should clarify the issue. Opinion.

flash_698537.description: Wintry weather in northern Israel and along the coast Wednesday to give way to rising temperatures, forecasters say.

flash_698535.description: We often thank G-d and then think, if only... It’s easy to focus on what we are lacking.

flash_698533.description: Presiding judge cites difficulties proving bribery and breach of trust in Case 4000, legal doubts over Case 2000, at a special hearing attended by Attorney General.

flash_698531.description: Communications Minister Shlomo Karhi was removed from a hearing of the special committee to repeal the broadcasting reform following a shouting match with committee chair Merav Ben Ari.

flash_698529.description: Israeli forces arrested two wanted suspects in Palestinian villages, one suspected of a series of home burglaries in southern Israel and the other of offenses related to illegal residency.

flash_698527.description: It comes down to having the courage to rid the world of nuclear peril and prolific terrorism. Opinion.

flash_698597.description:
Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor has died at 65.

Taylor died on Monday, according to a joint statement from his family and former bandmates that was shared on Duran Duran's official website on Wednesday. The statement said Taylor "passed away peacefully at home, surrounded by his family," after a "long and courageous battle with prostate cancer."

flash_698596.description: Jared Kushner defends Trump's Gaza peace plan, blames Palestinian governance for obstacles to a two-state solution and urges Israel to focus on economic diplomacy.

flash_698595.description: A two-year-old toddler suffers a severe head injury after falling from a height while playing. Doctors at Hadassah Ein Kerem Hospital were to pronounce him dead.

flash_698594.description: Peace and negotiations yes, but the red liines must be clear.

flash_698593.description: Five centuries after their ancestors were torn away from our people, the descendants of the Anousim are finding their way back, as Obadiah's prophecy predicted.

flash_698592.description: Our actions should reflect each one of those ways.

flash_698591.description: Whoever takes that first photograph may never learn who will use it or why. Tehran is building a capability that reaches beyond its ideological base. Op-ed.

flash_698590.description: A pedestrian's leg became trapped between a Jerusalem light rail car and the platform. Firefighters freed her using specialized equipment.

flash_698589.description: New Jersey declares a statewide emergency ahead of a Thanksgiving storm expected to bring heavy rain, 60 mph wind gusts, and coastal flooding.

flash_698588.description: Segal claims that the flaws in the cases against Netanyahu were known in advance and calls on the court to examine the responsibility of those who led the proceedings.

flash_698587.description: At least 30 people were killed and 15 injured after a truck carrying petroleum products overturned and exploded in Egypt, engulfing vehicles in flames.

flash_698586.description: A political source believes that Shas joining the government of change could jeopardize its political future and warns of the price Israel would have to pay for relying on Arab parties.

flash_698585.description: Rabbi Liraz Zeira, who was seriously wounded in Syria and lost both legs, recounts his struggle to survive, the faith that gave him strength and his dream of running again.

flash_698584.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi denies chemical weapons development and accuses Israel of seeking to draw the US into another war.

flash_698583.description: Yisrael Beytenu will receive the defense, justice, and immigration and absorption portfolios. Eisenkot is planning a government with fewer ministers, stirring resentment among his fellow bloc members.

flash_698582.description: Three NYC council members demand a civil rights investigation after a Hunter College event was canceled amid controversy over Hillel's participation.

flash_698581.description: Despite the judges' proposal to drop the bribery charge in Case 4000, Netanyahu does not currently intend to withdraw the pardon request he submitted to the president.

flash_698580.description: Hezbollah chief Naim Qassem accuses Lebanese President Joseph Aoun of deepening national divisions, defends Hezbollah's arms, and praises Iran.

flash_698579.description: The US president announced plans to impose new tariffs on at least 14 countries, including China, India, Japan and European Union member states.

flash_698578.description: The head of Ra'anana's hesder yeshiva calls for unity within religious Zionism and discusses military conscription for Haredim, his views on Bennett and his journey from secular school to leading a yeshiva.

flash_698577.description: Gadi Eisenkot and Avigdor Liberman have agreed that the justice minister will be appointed from the Yisrael Beytenu party, Channel 13 News reported.

flash_698576.description: MK Moshe Saada predicts an acquittal in Netanyahu's bribery case, levels serious accusations against law enforcement officials and says judges are giving the attorney general a chance to end proceedings before they write their verdict.

flash_698574.description: The Saudi-led coalition reported on Wednesday evening that a projectile fired by the Houthi terrorist militia fell on Jazan Port in Saudi Arabia, causing minor damage but no civilian casualties. Efforts are underway to determine the type of projectile.

flash_698573.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu delivers a statement in response to developments in his trial and the judges' remarks that the prosecution should consider its next steps in two of the cases against him. Watch live

flash_698572.description: IDF reveals stacks of UNICEF aid boxes were found at the site where Hamas's northern Gaza internal security chief Muhammad Abu al-Aouf was killed.

flash_698571.description: A court dismissed a NIS 5 million lawsuit against the PA. Attorney Yana Mano explains why proving a direct link between the policy of payments to terrorists and an attack makes it difficult for terror victims to obtain compensation.

flash_698570.description: MK Tally Gotliv explains why she believes the judges summoned the attorney general, proposes ending Netanyahu's trial without a plea bargain and calls for an investigation into the prosecution's conduct.

flash_698569.description: Musician and social media personality Shahar Ashkenazi missed an Ishay Ribo show she had booked for a break. Her tearful video went viral, and Ribo offered a new ticket. She told Arutz Sheva how her disappointment became a boost to her faith.

flash_698568.description: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir says the military will seek to ease the burden on reservists in 2027 while increasing readiness for renewed combat.

flash_698567.description: Likud has petitioned the Jerusalem District Court, seeking a review of the election results and the invalidation of results from polling stations where irregularities were found.

flash_698613.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un calls for broader deployment of tactical nuclear weapons, declaring that Pyongyang will never surrender its nuclear arsenal.

flash_698612.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards claim mounting costs will force the US to abandon its blockade, as a senior Iranian lawmaker threatens regional oil exports.

flash_698610.description: ISIS terrorists attack Syrian internal security forces in the northeastern city of Hasakah, killing two security personnel and wounding five others.

flash_698608.description: Clashes erupt outside a Brooklyn kosher deli hosting an Israeli real estate event as hundreds of pro-Israel supporters confront anti-Israel demonstrators.

flash_698606.description: Palestinian Arab sources reported that the Israeli strike early Thursday morning targeted a residential apartment in Deir al-Balah in the central Gaza Strip.

flash_698604.description: A short while ago, the IDF and ISA struck a senior terrorist in the Hamas terrorist organization in the Gaza Strip, the IDF Spokesperson's Unit said.

flash_698602.description: Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro criticizes Netanyahu's leadership and US policy toward Israel, leaving the door open to restrictions on offensive weapons sales.

flash_698600.description: Axios reports that Jared Kushner urged Netanyahu to advance Trump's Gaza peace plan, amid growing frustration within the administration over implementation delays.

flash_698598.description: The Knesset approves the repeal of the Broadcasting Law in its first reading by a vote of 51-32. Earlier, Minister Karhi was removed from a heated committee meeting.
